review_candidates.title: Mechanical Engineer – PMC Project
review_candidates.description: JOB DESCRIPTION Mechanical Engineer – PMC Project Project: KIMA Aswan Project Location: Aswan, Egypt Employment Type: PMC / Project Assignment Department: Mechanical Engineering / Construction Reports To: Lead Mechanical Engineer / Mechanical Manager 1. JOB PURPOSE The Mechanical Engineer will provide technical support and PMC oversight for mechanical engineering, procurement, construction, installation, testing, pre-commissioning, and commissioning activities for the KIMA Aswan Project. The role will act as a technical representative of the PMC/Client, ensuring that EPC contractor activities comply with approved engineering documents, project specifications, applicable codes and standards, construction schedules, quality requirements, and HSE procedures. The position will work closely with the Client, EPC Contractor, subcontractors, vendors, engineering teams, QA/QC, construction, commissioning, and other discipline teams. 2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Engineering & Technical Review Review and provide technical comments on mechanical engineering deliverables submitted by the EPC Contractor. Review mechanical drawings, specifications, datasheets, calculations, equipment layouts, P&IDs, piping layouts, and vendor documents. Verify engineering deliverables against project specifications, design basis, applicable codes, and Client requirements. Review equipment datasheets and technical documentation for mechanical equipment. Support resolution of technical queries, RFIs, design changes, and site engineering issues. Coordinate with process, piping, civil, electrical, instrumentation, and other engineering disciplines to resolve interfaces. Participate in technical meetings with the Client, EPC Contractor, consultants, and vendors. Review proposed deviations, substitutions, and design changes and provide technical recommendations. Mechanical Equipment Provide technical oversight for the procurement, installation, inspection, testing, and commissioning of mechanical equipment, including where applicable: Pumps and compressors Pressure vessels Heat exchangers Storage tanks Rotating equipment Static equipment Package equipment Mechanical skids Fans and blowers Agitators and mixers Conveyors and material-handling equipment Utility and process mechanical systems Review equipment installation requirements and vendor recommendations. Monitor equipment installation, alignment, levelling, grouting, coupling, lubrication, and preservation. Verify equipment installation against approved drawings and manufacturer's requirements. Participate in equipment inspections, testing, and performance verification. Piping & Mechanical Systems Monitor EPC Contractor piping and mechanical installation activities. Review piping layouts, isometric drawings, support arrangements, and installation procedures. Ensure piping installation is in accordance with approved drawings and specifications. Monitor pipe fabrication, erection, fit-up, supports, valves, fittings, flanges, and specialty items. Review and monitor hydrostatic and pneumatic testing activities. Monitor flushing, cleaning, blowing, drying, reinstatement, and preservation activities. Support resolution of piping and mechanical construction issues. Verify completion of piping systems prior to pre-commissioning and commissioning. 3. CONSTRUCTION SUPERVISION Monitor daily mechanical construction activities performed by the EPC Contractor and subcontractors. Verify that construction activities are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and project procedures. Monitor manpower, resources, productivity, and construction progress. Identify construction constraints and provide technical support to resolve them. Participate in daily and weekly construction coordination meetings. Monitor mechanical work fronts and ensure timely release of areas for construction. Coordinate mechanical activities with civil, electrical, instrumentation, and commissioning teams. Review contractor work sequences and provide technical input to improve project execution. Monitor compliance with approved construction schedules and milestones. Support recovery planning where mechanical activities fall behind schedule. 4. QUALITY ASSURANCE & QUALITY CONTROL Work closely with the QA/QC team to ensure mechanical works meet project quality requirements. Review and monitor compliance with approved Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs). Participate in mechanical inspections and equipment inspections. Review Inspection Requests, test reports, material certificates, and quality records. Monitor closure of mechanical NCRs and technical observations. Participate in system walkdowns and punch-list inspections. Ensure quality issues are identified and resolved before mechanical completion. Review mechanical completion dossiers and handover documentation. 5. PRE-COMMISSIONING & COMMISSIONING Provide mechanical engineering support during pre-commissioning and commissioning. Participate in mechanical system walkdowns and readiness reviews. Verify completion of mechanical installation prior to testing and commissioning. Support flushing, pressure testing, leak testing, equipment rotation checks, lubrication, and functional testing. Review commissioning procedures and provide technical comments. Support equipment start-up and troubleshooting activities. Participate in performance testing and equipment acceptance activities. Assist in resolving mechanical issues identified during commissioning. Verify completion of commissioning punch items. 6. PROCUREMENT & VENDOR COORDINATION Review technical documentation submitted by equipment vendors. Participate in technical bid evaluations where required. Review vendor drawings, datasheets, calculations, manuals, and inspection documentation. Participate in vendor inspection and Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), where applicable. Monitor vendor compliance with approved technical requirements. Coordinate with vendors to resolve technical and installation issues. Ensure vendor documentation is incorporated into project handover dossiers. 7. PROJECT CONTROLS & REPORTING Monitor mechanical engineering and construction progress against the approved project schedule. Provide regular updates on mechanical activities, issues, risks, and constraints. Prepare technical reports and progress updates as required. Identify potential delays and recommend mitigation measures. Monitor contractor deliverables and outstanding technical actions. Maintain records of technical queries, design changes, inspections, punch items, and project actions. Support preparation of weekly and monthly PMC reports. 8. HSE RESPONSIBILITIES Ensure all mechanical activities are carried out in accordance with project HSE requirements. Participate in site safety inspections and toolbox meetings where required. Identify unsafe mechanical construction practices and ensure corrective actions are implemented. Ensure contractors comply with approved lifting, equipment installation, pressure testing, and other mechanical safety procedures. Promote a strong safety culture throughout project execution. Stop or escalate activities where serious safety or technical risks are identified. 9. CODES & STANDARDS The candidate should have good working knowledge of applicable international standards and project specifications, including as relevant: ASME API ASTM ISO AWS NFPA IEC – where mechanical/electrical interfaces apply Relevant pressure equipment and piping standards Client and EPC project specifications 10. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university. Professional engineering certification or membership is an advantage. Additional certifications related to mechanical inspection, pressure equipment, rotating equipment, piping, or project management are advantageous. 11. EXPERIENCE Minimum 10–15 years of relevant mechanical engineering experience , preferably within major industrial projects. Previous experience working on PMC, EPCM, Client, or major EPC projects is strongly preferred. Experience in fertilizer, ammonia/urea, chemical, petrochemical, power, or process plant projects is highly desirable. Strong experience in mechanical equipment, piping, static and rotating equipment, construction, testing, and commissioning. Experience supervising EPC Contractors and subcontractors. Experience in large-scale brownfield or greenfield industrial projects is advantageous. Previous experience in Egypt or the MENA region would be an advantage.
